summary: Creative stacking toy for kids: explore physics and make spectacular BOOM!
description:
BUILD, STACK… AND MAKE EVERYTHING EXPLODE!
The cubes are ready… it’s your turn to play! Tower, castle, skyscraper, brick house or gigantic bridge: anything becomes possible thanks to your imagination.

Merge two cubes of the same color to create new blocks, place explosive blocks to make everything collapse in a shower of sparks, and trigger real chain reactions: KABOOM!

In Pango Kaboom, your child builds, stacks, assembles and experiments freely. A creative game that develops imagination from age 3. A simple, joyful experience full of discoveries, encouraging fine motor skills and autonomous exploration, without constraints or stress.

15 YEARS DEDICATED TO FREE PLAY
With more than 20 acclaimed apps, downloaded by over 15 million children, Pango has become a reference for parents seeking smart and caring games.
Pango Kaboom follows this tradition: a sensory and creative game designed to develop imagination, logic, and the pleasure of building… or destroying!

WHY DO PARENTS LOVE PANGO KABOOM?
✓ Develops fine motor skills and coordination
✓ Encourages creativity and imagination
✓ Helps children intuitively understand physics, balance and cause-and-effect
✓ Offers more than 100 ready-made constructions to explore
✓ Intuitive experience designed for small hands
✓ Colorful, expressive, non-competitive universe
✓ Perfect for quick moments, trips or quiet time

A 100% SAFE GAME WITH NO ADS
• No in-app purchases
• No advertising
• No external links
• Secure Parents section
• Compliant with children’s privacy protection rules

PANGO VALUES: KINDNESS, CREATIVITY, SIMPLICITY
For more than 15 years, our team has been creating games that respect children’s pace, stimulate their curiosity, value their achievements, and encourage independent discovery.

We remain available to support you: pango@studio-pango.com

More info: www.studio-pango.com

DOWNLOAD PANGO KABOOM and let your child build, imagine… then make everything explode: BUILD, PLAY… AND BOOM!
